caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance of three different trigger insertion strategies—labeled "start", "random", and "end"—across a set of trigger words on the horizontal axis, which are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model. The vertical axis represents the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) score, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale. The "start" strategy is depicted by a solid green line with circular markers, beginning at an ASR of approximately 0.74 for the trigger word "bb" and rising to a peak of approximately 0.93 for "stunning" before slightly declining to about 0.91 for "beautifully". The "random" strategy is shown as an orange line with 'x' markers, starting at an ASR of approximately 0.10 for "bb", dropping to about 0.08 for "mb", then rising steadily to approximately 0.85 for "stunning" and ending at about 0.83 for "beautifully". The "end" strategy is represented by a purple line with circular markers, beginning at an ASR of approximately 0.40 for "bb", dropping to about 0.42 for "mb", then rising sharply to a peak of approximately 0.90 for "cf" before fluctuating between approximately 0.60 and 0.85 for the remaining triggers.
